mapper.select:
SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,version_no versionNo,title,summary, LEFT(COALESCE(content,''),400) excerpt,status,confidence, change_type changeType,changed_by changedBy,supersedes_version_no supersedesVersionNo, created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_version
ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT object_type objectType,change_type changeType,COUNT(*) total, MAX(created_time) latestTime FROM t_knowledge_version WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY object_type,change_type ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT 'CARD' objectType,status,COUNT(*) total FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,status,COUNT(*) total FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY status

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,e.status evidenceStatus, link.support_type supportType,link.support_score supportScore, s.name sourceName,s.source_type sourceType, d.title documentTitle,d.document_code documentCode, cu.unit_code contentUnitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.page_end pageEnd FROM t_evidence e JOIN ( SELECT ce.evidence_id evidence_id,ce.support_type support_type,ce.support_score support_score FROM t_claim_evidence ce WHERE #{objectType}='CLAIM' AND ce.claim_code=#{objectCode} UNION ALL SELECT ke.evidence_id evidence_id,ke.support_type support_type,ke.support_score support_score FROM t_knowledge_evidence ke WHERE #{objectType}='CARD' AND ke.knowledge_code=#{objectCode} ) link ON link.evidence_id=e.id JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY e.id

SELECT COUNT(*) answerCount, COALESCE(SUM(factual_claim_count),0) claimCount, COALESCE(SUM(supported_claim_count),0) supportedClaimCount, COALESCE(SUM(citation_count),0) citationCount, COALESCE(AVG(faithfulness_score),0) faithfulness, COALESCE(AVG(completeness_score),0) completeness, MAX(created_time) latestTime FROM ( SELECT factual_claim_count,supported_claim_count,citation_count,faithfulness_score,completeness_score,created_time FROM t_answer_evidence_assessment WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN updated_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{withinDays} DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) freshCount, SUM(CASE WHEN valid_to IS NOT NULL AND valid_to < NOW() AND status NOT IN ('EXPIRED','SUPERSEDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) expiredCount, MAX(updated_time) latestUpdate FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status='PENDING_REVIEW') pendingReview, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status='PENDING_REVIEW') pendingCardReview, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status='OPEN') openConflict, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ingestion_run WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status='FAILED') failedIngestion, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status='UNCERTAIN') uncertainClaim, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status='CONFLICTED') conflictedClaim

SELECT r.run_code runCode,r.mode,r.status,r.case_count caseCount, r.hit_at1_rate hitAt1Rate,r.hit_at3_rate hitAt3Rate,r.hit_at5_rate hitAt5Rate, r.recall_at5 recallAt5,r.mrr,r.ndcg_at10 ndcgAt10, r.latency_p50_ms latencyP50Ms,r.latency_p95_ms latencyP95Ms, r.citation_accuracy citationAccuracy,r.regression_verdict regressionVerdict, r.finished_time finishedTime,d.name datasetName FROM t_evaluation_run r LEFT JOIN t_evaluation_dataset d ON d.id=r.dataset_id WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND r.status='SUCCESS' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,c.claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(c.subject,' ',c.predicate,' ',c.object_value) objectContent,c.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.evidence_id) evidenceCount,COUNT(DISTINCT e.source_id) sourceCount,COALESCE(AVG(e.authority_score),0) authorityScore,COALESCE(AVG(e.freshness_score),0) freshnessScore, COALESCE(MAX(cf.conflictCount),0) conflictCount,COALESCE(MAX(cf.maxConflictScore),0) maxConflictScore,c.status FROM t_claim c LEFT JOIN t_claim_evidence ce ON ce.claim_code=c.claim_code LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ce.evidence_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT objectCode,COUNT(*) conflictCount,MAX(conflictScore) maxConflictScore FROM ( SELECT object_a_code objectCode,conflict_score conflictScore FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' UNION ALL SELECT object_b_code objectCode,conflict_score conflictScore FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' ) conflict_rows GROUP BY objectCode ) cf ON cf.objectCode=c.claim_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') GROUP BY c.id UNION ALL SELECT 'CARD' objectType,k.knowledge_code objectCode,CONCAT(k.title,' ',k.content) objectContent,k.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ke.evidence_id) evidenceCount,COUNT(DISTINCT e.source_id) sourceCount,COALESCE(AVG(e.authority_score),0) authorityScore,COALESCE(AVG(e.freshness_score),0) freshnessScore,0 conflictCount,0 maxConflictScore,k.status FROM t_knowledge_card k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_evidence ke ON ke.knowledge_code=k.knowledge_code LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ke.evidence_id WHERE k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND k.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') GROUP BY k.id

SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,decision,reviewer, comment_text comment,created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_review WHERE object_type=#{objectType} AND object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,policy_version policyVersion, knowledge_confidence knowledgeConfidence,risk_level riskLevel,decision, requires_human_review requiresHumanReview,score_json scoreJson, ai_judge_json aiJudgeJson,reason_text reasonText,created_time createdTime FROM t_adjudication_assessment WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND object_type=#{objectType} AND object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT object_a_code objectACode,object_b_code objectBCode,conflict_type conflictType,conflict_score conflictScore,status FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' AND (object_a_code=#{objectCode} OR object_b_code=#{objectCode})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_adjudication_assessment(knowledge_base_id,object_type,object_code,policy_version,knowledge_confidence,risk_level,decision,requires_human_review,score_json,ai_judge_json,reason_text) VALUES(#{kb},#{objectType},#{objectCode},#{policyVersion},#{confidence},#{riskLevel},#{decision},#{requiresHuman},CAST(#{scoreJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{aiJson} AS JSON),#{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,policy_version policyVersion,knowledge_confidence knowledgeConfidence,risk_level riskLevel,decision,requires_human_review requiresHumanReview,score_json scoreJson,ai_judge_json aiJudgeJson,reason_text reasonText,created_time createdTime FROM t_adjudication_assessment WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_card SET status=#{status} WHERE knowledge_code=#{code}
UPDATE t_claim SET status=#{status} WHERE claim_code=#{code}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,c.object_a_code objectACode,c.object_b_code objectBCode, c.conflict_type conflictType,c.conflict_score conflictScore,c.status,c.resolution,c.created_time createdTime, a.objectType objectAType,a.displayTitle objectATitle,a.content objectAContent,a.status objectAStatus,a.confidence objectAConfidence,a.versionNo objectAVersion, b.objectType objectBType,b.displayTitle objectBTitle,b.content objectBContent,b.status objectBStatus,b.confidence objectBConfidence,b.versionNo objectBVersion FROM t_knowledge_conflict c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'CARD' objectType,knowledge_code code,title displayTitle,CONCAT(title,'：',LEFT(COALESCE(summary,content),200)) content,status,confidence,version versionNo FROM t_knowledge_card UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,claim_code code,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',LEFT(object_value,120)) displayTitle,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',object_value) content,status,confidence, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM t_knowledge_version v WHERE v.object_type='CLAIM' AND v.object_code=cv.claim_code),1) versionNo FROM t_claim cv ) a ON a.code=c.object_a_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'CARD' objectType,knowledge_code code,title displayTitle,CONCAT(title,'：',LEFT(COALESCE(summary,content),200)) content,status,confidence,version versionNo FROM t_knowledge_card UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,claim_code code,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',LEFT(object_value,120)) displayTitle,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',object_value) content,status,confidence, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM t_knowledge_version v WHERE v.object_type='CLAIM' AND v.object_code=cv.claim_code),1) versionNo FROM t_claim cv ) b ON b.code=c.object_b_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (#{status} IS NULL OR c.status=#{status}) ORDER BY c.conflict_score DESC,c.created_time DESC

SELECT id,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,object_a_code objectACode,object_b_code objectBCode,conflict_type conflictType,conflict_score conflictScore,status,resolution,created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',LEFT(object_value,200)) content,condition_json conditionJson,confidence,status,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM t_knowledge_version v WHERE v.object_type='CLAIM' AND v.object_code=claim_code),1) versionNo FROM t_claim WHERE claim_code IN #{code} UNION ALL SELECT 'CARD' objectType,knowledge_code objectCode,CONCAT(title,'：',LEFT(COALESCE(summary,content),200)) content,NULL conditionJson,confidence,status,COALESCE(version,1) versionNo FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_code IN #{code}

SELECT pending.* FROM ( SELECT 'CARD' objectType,t.knowledge_code objectCode,t.title displayTitle,t.confidence,t.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_conflict c WHERE c.status='OPEN' AND (c.object_a_code=t.knowledge_code OR c.object_b_code=t.knowledge_code)) conflictCount FROM t_knowledge_card t WHERE t.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND t.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,t.claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(t.subject,' ',t.predicate,' ',LEFT(t.object_value,120)) displayTitle,t.confidence,t.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_conflict c WHERE c.status='OPEN' AND (c.object_a_code=t.claim_code OR c.object_b_code=t.claim_code)) conflictCount FROM t_claim t WHERE t.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND t.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') ) pending ORDER BY CASE WHEN pending.status='CONFLICTED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,pending.conflictCount DESC,pending.confidence ASC

SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_claim WHERE claim_code=#{objectCode} AND UPPER(#{objectType})='CLAIM' UNION ALL SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_code=#{objectCode} AND UPPER(#{objectType})!='CLAIM' LIMIT 1
